polizas.querySql:
WITH vehiculos AS (
  SELECT
    vh.cpoliza,
    vh.xplaca,
    TRIM(vh.xsercar) AS xsercar,
    TRIM(vh.xsermot) AS xsermot,
    TRIM(vh.xcolor) AS xcolor,
    vh.cano,
    inma.xmarca,
    inma.xmodelo,
    inma.xversion,
    vh.fanopol,
    vh.fmespol,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY vh.cpoliza, vh.fanopol, vh.fmespol
      ORDER BY vh.xplaca
    ) AS rn
  FROM vhcerti vh
  LEFT JOIN mavinma inma
    ON vh.cano = inma.qano
    AND vh.cmarca = inma.cmarca
    AND vh.cmodelo = inma.cmodelo
    AND vh.cversion = inma.cversion
)
SELECT
  CAST(TRIM(pol.cnpoliza) AS varchar(30)) AS numero_poliza,
  CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(pol.cnpoliza_rel), '') AS varchar(30)) AS numero_poliza_relacionada,
  CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.forigen, '1900-01-01'), pol.fdesde) AS datetime) AS fecha_emision_poliza,
  CAST(pol.fdesde AS datetime) AS fecha_desde_poliza,
  CAST(pol.fhasta AS datetime) AS fecha_hasta_poliza,
  CASE WHEN pol.iestado = 'N' THEN 'NO VIGENTE' ELSE 'VIGENTE' END AS estado,
  CAST(TRIM(mram.xdescripcion_l) AS varchar(100)) AS ramo,
  CAST(TRIM(tr.xdescripcion_l) AS varchar(100)) AS tipo_ramo,
  CASE
    WHEN pol.cramo = 18 THEN CAST(pl.xplan AS varchar(100))
    ELSE CAST(plp.xplan AS varchar(100))
  END AS [plan],
  CASE pol.itipopol
    WHEN 'N' THEN 'Nueva'
    WHEN 'R' THEN 'Renovación'
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'Adicional'
    ELSE CAST(ISNULL(pol.itipopol, '') AS varchar(40))
  END AS forma,
  CASE pol.ifrecuencia
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'Anual'
    WHEN 'M' THEN 'Mensual'
    WHEN 'T' THEN 'Trimestral'
    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Semestral'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contado'
    ELSE CAST(ISNULL(pol.ifrecuencia, '') AS varchar(30))
  END AS frecuencia,
  CAST(TRIM(sp.xdescripcion_l) AS varchar(100)) AS sucursal,
  CAST(ISNULL(mcanal.xcanalalt, '') AS varchar(100)) AS canal_venta,
  CAST(ISNULL(mcanal.xcanalalt, '') AS varchar(100)) AS canal_alterno,
  CAST(ISNULL(mpro.xproductor, '') AS varchar(150)) AS productor,
  CASE
    WHEN pol.istatpol = 'A' OR (rc.nrec > 0 AND rc.nanul = rc.nrec) THEN 'ANULADO'
    WHEN rc.npend > 0 THEN 'PENDIENTE'
    ELSE 'PAGADO'
  END AS estatus_poliza,
  CAST(CASE
    WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(pol.cmoneda)) IN ('USD', '$') THEN 'DOLARES'
    WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(pol.cmoneda)) IN ('EUR', '€') THEN 'EUROS'
    WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(pol.cmoneda)) IN ('BS', 'VES', 'VED', 'BOLIVARES') THEN 'BOLIVARES'
    ELSE ISNULL(mmon.xdescripcion_l, pol.cmoneda)
  END AS varchar(30)) AS moneda,
  CAST(ISNULL(rc.prima_ext, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS prima_total,
  CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(cli_tenedor.xcliente), '') AS varchar(240)) AS nombre_tomador,
  CAST(ISNULL(cli_tenedor.cid, '') AS varchar(30)) AS cedula_tomador,
  CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(cli_asegurado.xcliente), '') AS varchar(240)) AS nombre_asegurado,
  CAST(ISNULL(cli_asegurado.cid, '') AS varchar(30)) AS cedula_asegurado,
  CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(cli_benef.xcliente), '') AS varchar(240)) AS nombre_beneficiario_preferencial,
  CAST(ISNULL(cli_benef.cid, '') AS varchar(30)) AS cedula_beneficiario_preferencial,
  CAST(vh.xmarca AS varchar(100)) AS marca_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.xmodelo AS varchar(100)) AS modelo_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.xversion AS varchar(100)) AS version_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.cano AS int) AS anio_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.xplaca AS varchar(30)) AS placa,
  CAST(vh.xcolor AS varchar(60)) AS color_vehiculo,
  CAST(vh.xsercar AS varchar(60)) AS serial_carroceria,
  CAST(vh.xsermot AS varchar(60)) AS serial_motor,
  CAST(pol.cramo AS int) AS id_ramo,
  CAST(ISNULL(mpro.cproductor, 0) AS int) AS id_productor,
  CAST(ISNULL(mcanal.ccanalalt, 0) AS int) AS id_canal,
  COALESCE(pol.fultmod, pol.forigen, pol.fdesde) AS modified_at
FROM adpoliza pol
LEFT JOIN maramos mram WITH (NOLOCK) ON mram.cramo = pol.cramo
LEFT JOIN matiporamo tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON mram.ctiporamo = tr.ctiporamo
LEFT JOIN maplanes pl WITH (NOLOCK) ON pl.cramo = pol.cramo AND pl.cplan = pol.cplan
LEFT JOIN maplanes_per plp WITH (NOLOCK) ON plp.cramo = pol.cramo AND plp.cplan = pol.cplan
LEFT JOIN masucur sp WITH (NOLOCK) ON pol.csucurrec = sp.csucur
LEFT JOIN macanalalt mcanal WITH (NOLOCK) ON mcanal.ccanalalt = TRY_CAST(RTRIM(pol.ccanalalt) AS SMALLINT)
LEFT JOIN maproduc mpro WITH (NOLOCK) ON mpro.cproductor = pol.cproductor
LEFT JOIN mamonedas mmon WITH (NOLOCK) ON mmon.cmoneda = pol.cmoneda
LEFT JOIN maclient cli_tenedor WITH (NOLOCK) ON cli_tenedor.cci_rif = pol.ctenedor
LEFT JOIN maclient cli_asegurado WITH (NOLOCK) ON cli_asegurado.cci_rif = pol.casegurado
LEFT JOIN maclient cli_benef WITH (NOLOCK) ON cli_benef.cci_rif = pol.cbeneficiario
LEFT JOIN vehiculos vh ON vh.cpoliza = pol.cpoliza AND vh.fanopol = pol.fanopol AND vh.fmespol = pol.fmespol AND vh.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT r.cpoliza, r.fanopol, r.fmespol,
    COUNT(*) AS nrec,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.iestadorec = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npend,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.iestadorec = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nanul,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.iestadorec <> 'A' THEN r.mprimabrutaext ELSE 0 END) AS prima_ext
  FROM adrecibos r WITH (NOLOCK)
  GROUP BY r.cpoliza, r.fanopol, r.fmespol
) rc ON rc.cpoliza = pol.cpoliza AND rc.fanopol = pol.fanopol AND rc.fmespol = pol.fmespol
WHERE (@desde IS NULL OR CAST(/*SYNC_DATE_COL*/ AS date) >= @desde)
AND (@hasta IS NULL OR CAST(/*SYNC_DATE_COL*/ AS date) <= @hasta)
AND (@poliza IS NULL OR pol.cnpoliza = @poliza)
AND (@ramo IS NULL OR pol.cramo = @ramo)
AND (@productor IS NULL OR mpro.cproductor = @productor)
AND (@canal IS NULL OR mcanal.ccanalalt = @canal)
AND (@moneda IS NULL OR
  CASE
    WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(pol.cmoneda)) IN ('USD', '$') THEN 'DOLARES'
    WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(pol.cmoneda)) IN ('EUR', '€') THEN 'EUROS'
    WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(pol.cmoneda)) IN ('BS', 'VES', 'VED', 'BOLIVARES') THEN 'BOLIVARES'
    ELSE ISNULL(mmon.xdescripcion_l, pol.cmoneda)
  END = @moneda
)
AND (@iestatopol IS NULL OR CASE
  WHEN pol.istatpol = 'A' OR (rc.nrec > 0 AND rc.nanul = rc.nrec) THEN 'ANULADO'
  WHEN rc.npend > 0 THEN 'PENDIENTE'
  ELSE 'PAGADO'
  END = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(@iestatopol))))
/*SYNC_WHERE*/
/*SYNC_ORDER BY*/
